Foreign license conversion - Misrad HaRishui Karmiel

The only branch with an available appointment was Karmiel, so I drove up from the center specifically for this. Everything went smoothly and they assured me I was all set, but said they could only release my new license the following Monday due to a technicality.
Monday has come and gone, and I haven't received an email or a call. My partner and I have tried calling every line available, but we can't reach anyone who can help. Meanwhile, my foreign license has expired so I can’t try again somewhere else. 

It’s so frustrating because it’s likely just a quick oversight on their end. I don’t know anyone in Karmiel but I wonder if I should try to just find someone to go ask for me 🫠

Does anyone know if there’s a direct way to reach the Karmiel branch, or have advice on how to get them to release it?
